title: Deformations of morphisms of coherent sheaves
summary: We generalise Hinich's Theorem of descent of Deligne groupoids to the case where the dgLas involved have no negative cohomology. We apply this result to study the infinitesimal deformations of a morphism $α: {\mathcal F} \to {\mathcal G}$ of coherent sheaves, where both the sheaves $ {\mathcal F}$ and $ {\mathcal G}$ and the map $α$ can be deformed, on a smooth variety over a field of characteristic zero. In particular, we provide an explicit dgLa that controls these deformations via the Deligne functor, applying the Thom-Whitney totalisation to a specific semicosimplicial dgLa, constructed…
